info.title: Tassyir Admin API
info.summary: The API installed apps call to read and change a Tassyir business, and the webhooks they receive.
info.description:
Version `2026-10` of the API installed Tassyir apps call. The routes live under `/apps/2026-10/`; the token endpoint and the key documents under `/apps/`. Generated from the code by `npm run apps:openapi`; the developer reference is docs/api/apps/.

**Authentication.** `Authorization: Bearer tsy_at_…` from `POST /apps/oauth/token`. An app acts as a team member of the business: it reads and writes only what its granted scopes allow, only in the stores the merchant gave it, under the merchant's plan.

**Conventions.** JSON fields are camelCase; ids are strings; times are ISO 8601 UTC; money is a decimal string (`"2500.00"`) with a `currency` field, never a number. A list answers `{ data, nextCursor }`, newest first, keyset-paged: `limit` 1 to 100 (default 50), `cursor` = the previous `nextCursor`. A single resource answers `{ data }`. `fields` trims a resource to the named top-level fields. Fields without `read_customer_contact` (buyer name, phones, address, notes) are omitted, not nulled. Every answer is `Cache-Control: no-store`.

**Writes.** Send an `Idempotency-Key` to make a write safe to retry (24 hours per installation).

**Errors.** `application/problem+json` with a stable `code`, a `fix` sentence and a `requestId`. Each operation lists every code it can answer. HTTP 460 `STORE_SCOPE_FORBIDDEN` means a store outside the installation's stores.

**Rate limits.** A leaky bucket per installation, by default 40 requests refilled at 4 a second: every answer carries `RateLimit-Limit`, `RateLimit-Remaining` and `RateLimit-Reset`; a refusal is 429 `RATE_LIMITED` with `Retry-After`.

**Webhooks.** Signed Standard Webhooks deliveries (`v1a`, Ed25519), one per topic below; verify them with `GET /apps/webhook-keys`.
